_meta.scope: COMBAT-SIDE skill cards. These are cards - 3 of them sit in a 20-card loadout (14 class + 3 weapon + 3 skill). Not to be confused with story-side PROFICIENCIES (seed_reference.json).
_meta.authority: CANONICAL for skill card text. Revision 2026-08-01: user-confirmed expansion and errata pass.
_meta.printNote: Green category bar (#2e6e62 / text #cdeee4). ON DRAW uses a purple circle (#6a4a8a) with the glyph.

errata: Endurance: caps only the FIRST hit this turn (was every hit until your next turn).
Keen Eye: works on non-stash attacks only.
revision_2026_08_01.split: Alchemy removed; replaced by Cinderbrand (Burn) and Venomcraft (Poison 3), one rider each.
revision_2026_08_01.renames: Herbalism>Poultice, Cooking>Hearty Meal, Blacksmithing>Whetstone, Survival>Sidestep, Hunting>Take Aim, Animal Handling>Wild Companion, Athletics>Sprint.
revision_2026_08_01.added: 18 new cards, user-selected from a 30-candidate slate. All conditionals read persistent board state (a condition on the enemy, your Block) - never a second card in the same hand.
revision_2026_08_01.ruleNote: Regen decays: heals N at end of round, then N drops by 1 (mirror of Poison).

removed: and all 8 brewed cards (Snare, Poisoner, Healing Draught x3, Improvised Bomb x3)
REMOVED_DO_NOT_REINSTATE.reason: Crafting is story-side only: a camp action, six disciplines gated by proficiencies, output going to the pouch. The old Crafting skill cards produced brewed cards into the DECK or STASH, which violates the pouch-isolation law (pouch cards are never in hand, deck, or discard) and duplicated four pouch consumables one-for-one.
REMOVED_DO_NOT_REINSTATE.decision: Removed by design call, confirmed 2026-08-01. The skill pool is 44 cards after the expansion.
REMOVED_DO_NOT_REINSTATE.guard: Do not re-add crafting to the skill pool. If a combat-side crafting verb is ever wanted, it must not create cards in the deck or stash, and it must not duplicate a pouch consumable.

_meta.nameCollisionNote: RESOLVED 2026-08-01: every skill card that shared a name with a proficiency has been renamed (see revision_2026_08_01.renames). No skill card now collides with a proficiency or a crafting discipline.

skillCards.name: Poultice
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Herbalism 2026-08-01 - proficiency collision resolved. Regen decays: heals N, then N drops by 1.

skillCards.name: Hearty Meal
skillCards.effect: Heal **3**; that ally gains **+1 Strength & Focus** next turn.
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Cooking 2026-08-01 - collision with the Cooking crafting discipline resolved.

skillCards.name: Rally
skillCards.effect: That ally gains **3** Block and clears **1 Stagger**.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. The only ally Stagger-cleanse in the pool.

skillCards.name: Evensong
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. First AoE heal. Scales with party size; overheal is wasted.

skillCards.name: Endurance
skillCards.effect: Gain **Bulwark 5** for the first hit you take this turn.
skillCards.notes: ERRATA 2026-08-01: caps only the FIRST hit this turn (was: every hit until your next turn).

skillCards.name: Whetstone
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Blacksmithing 2026-08-01 - crafting-flavoured name retired with the crafting cut.

skillCards.name: Shield Wall
skillCards.effect: Gain **4** Block. If you already have Block, gain **6** instead.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Gate reads persistent state (your Block), never a sibling card.

skillCards.name: Brace
skillCards.effect: Gain **4** Block and **+1 Physical Armor** until your next turn.

skillCards.name: Muscle Memory
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Whetstone's shape for the Dexterity keyword (block generation).

skillCards.name: Sidestep
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Survival 2026-08-01 - proficiency collision resolved.

skillCards.name: Bodyguard
skillCards.target: React - when an ally is attacked

skillCards.name: Instinct
skillCards.effect: Gain **3** Block and **+1 Strength & Focus** this turn.
skillCards.notes: Mills never fire when-drawn effects - established scope rule.

skillCards.name: Parry
skillCards.effect: Gain **3** Block and apply **1 Stagger** to the attacker.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Trades 2 Block against Sidestep for tempo on the attacker.

skillCards.name: Counterstroke
skillCards.effect: Gain **2** Block. If the attacker is Staggered, deal **3** Physical back.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. The only damaging React. Gate reads persistent state.

skillCards.name: Keen Eye
skillCards.effect: Gain **Precise** this turn - your next non-stash attack rolls its max die.
skillCards.notes: NERF 2026-08-01: 'non-stash' added. Stash cards can no longer be max-rolled.

skillCards.name: Take Aim
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Hunting 2026-08-01 - proficiency-adjacent name retired (Hunt is a camp action).

skillCards.name: Feint
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Prep card - sets up Stagger payoffs across turns, the legal combo shape.

skillCards.name: Iron Regimen
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Whetstone's offensive twin. EXHAUST because permanent damage snowballs where permanent armor caps.

skillCards.name: Hex
skillCards.effect: Deal **1d6** Magical. If the enemy is Weakened, apply **Weaken 2** more.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Repeatable Old Lore variant - the rider is gated on persistent state instead of EXHAUST.

skillCards.name: Hamstring
skillCards.effect: Deal **2** Physical and apply **1 Stagger**; **2 Stagger** instead if the enemy is Bleeding.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Bleed payoff. Watch item: Bleed sources are weapon-side only, so the rider is weapon-synergy tech.

skillCards.name: Find the Gap
skillCards.effect: Your attacks are **Piercing** this turn (ignore matching Armor).
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Fast so it resolves before the attacks it modifies. Tech card - dead vs soft targets.

skillCards.name: Cinderbrand
skillCards.notes: Split from Alchemy 2026-08-01 (Burn half). Burn refreshes duration, never stacks.

skillCards.name: Venomcraft
skillCards.notes: Split from Alchemy 2026-08-01 (Poison half).

skillCards.name: Wild Companion
skillCards.effect: Place a Persistent critter (out of deck): deals **2** Physical to a random enemy each round.
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Animal Handling 2026-08-01 - proficiency collision resolved.

skillCards.name: Plague Touch
skillCards.effect: Apply **Poison 2**. If the enemy is already Poisoned, deal **3** Magical now.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Instant payoff instead of stacking - checks before applying.

skillCards.name: Bramble Ward
skillCards.effect: Place a Persistent bramble (out of deck): the first enemy to attack each round takes **2** Physical.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Wild Companion's cost-shape, reactive instead of random-target.

skillCards.name: Leechcraft
skillCards.effect: Move **1** debuff from the target onto an enemy.
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Cleanse and apply in one - transfers, never copies.

skillCards.name: Sprint
skillCards.effect: Gain **+1 Normal or Slow** play this round.
skillCards.notes: Renamed from Athletics 2026-08-01 - proficiency collision resolved. Not Fast - Fast is premium. Same law as the Nomad background.

skillCards.name: Second Wind
skillCards.effect: Draw **2** cards. You cannot draw more cards this turn.

skillCards.name: Footwork
skillCards.effect: Change one of your timing slots to **ANY** this turn.

skillCards.name: Meditation
skillCards.effect: Remove all debuffs from yourself and heal **2**.

skillCards.name: Inner Flame
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. Iron Regimen's caster twin. Named to avoid the Focus stat.

skillCards.name: Shake It Off
skillCards.notes: NEW 2026-08-01. The fast Stagger-specific answer; Meditation covers debuffs at Slow.
